title: Fantastical!
text: This was a wonderful tour when you can't get tickets for inside. They kept us updated on time changes and our guide was very conscientious, speaking slowly and moving at a pace we could all keep up with, very informative. Excellent tour.
author: F4256CDpamelaw

title: Pepa is a sweetheart. We...
text: Pepa is a sweetheart. He taught us around the Alhambra with a passion for its city and impressive delicacy. We learned a lot
author: Andrea_S

title: Splendid walk-around of the Alhambra
text: Our guide had a great sense of humor and shared a wealth of information about the mixing of cultures in Granada. Even without admission to the paid areas of the Alhambra, the tour was very much worth doing.
author: William_R

title: An unforgettable visit
text:
An immersive experience in history and art, full of anecdotes, smiles and exquisite attention. This was our visit to the Alhambra with Javi Suárez.

We had already traveled with him to Turkey before and enjoyed it very much, so having the opportunity to visit the Alhambra with him as a guide has been an incredible experience.

We recommend it and we would repeat the visit without a doubt.
Thank you!
author: mar_apE5717RC

title: Today the Alhambra is in my heart.
text: If the Alhambra seemed spectacular, having the good fortune to have a guide like Javi Suarez accompany you, makes me leave Granada today with a sweet and nostalgic aftertaste. Unbeatable a pleasant and participatory visit, pending at all times of your group and infecting us with your passion for history and art. Thanks for everything. Conception, M Joseph, and Grace. Asturias and Basque Country.
author: Tourist552010

title: Amazing experience with tour guide Ana
text: Our guide, Ana was absolutely incredible. Our favorite tour in Spain. She was extremely knowledgeable, and we really enjoyed learning the history of the sites. She was also a local, which was awesome. She was able to point out a lot of surrounding sites as well. She also recommended great restaurants, which were all some of our favorites during our 2 week trip in Spain. Highly recommend this service!!
author: vaninabs19283940

title: Nice experience
text:
Javier knew how to make our visit to the Alhambra much more than that, giving us a whole experience to the whole family, knowing how to capture the attention and encourage curiosity to learn from our three children.
Amazing afternoon with four hours of explanation and learning for both big and small!
Thank you Javier!
author: raulmR5554JR

title: Alhambra
text: Excellent visit thanks to Ana Diaz. A pleasant and very interesting tour worth recommending. Of course we will repeat.
author: Q5672OTmartac

title: Magic Alhambra
text:
Thank you to Javier for his magic when it comes to getting us into the amazing world of Andalusian culture. It was an exceptional tour, we had never enjoyed so much.
He is the best guide you can find and the only one who gets an immersive role in the history of the Alhambra. It was a pleasure to have met him and to have him solve all possible doubts. 
Greetings from Toledo, Felipe and Itzi.
author: Icii16

title: Visit to Alhambra with F. Javier Suarez
text: The visit was unbeatable, we were seven people and of them three children. Javier was able to connect at all times with the children keeping them attentive for almost 4 hours. THE language used in this guide is very affordable and makes the visit very enjoyable, it introduces you to history in such a way that you can imagine what palaces and gardens could be like in their most splendorful times. It was a great day. I recommend you can visit with this great guide.
author: nievesr770
